agent_explanation: Controller adds seeded sensor noise (0.209) to measurement/error before computing force, but fmax clamp is applied before noise or not applied after. In shrunk scenario at step 1 noisy force 144.736 > fmax 111.335. Setting noise=0 removes violation, proving noise bypasses limit check. Increasing fmax to 200 still violates (force 260 > 200) showing clamping is ineffective when noise present.
